channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: US faces rising costs with Iran war driving energy prices, inflation higher
item.description: Consumer prices spike in April, driven by soaring energy costs, with petrol prices up nearly 30 percent since last year.

item.title: Kuwait says it foils infiltration operation by Iran’s IRGC
item.description: Kuwait arrests four men it accuses of being in Revolutionary Guard and conducting failed infiltration of Bubiyan Island.

item.title: Pentagon gives new $29bn Iran war price tag, downplays munitions concerns
item.description: Appearing before congressional panel, Defense Secretary Hegseth says US is prepared to either escalate or wind down war.

item.title: Israel killing at least one child a week in occupied West Bank, UN says
item.description: Israeli military and settlers have killed at least one Palestinian child a week on average in the occupied West Bank.

item.title: A secret Israeli base in Iraq? What we know
item.description: Israeli troops reportedly used this base to launch attacks against Iran during the war.

item.title: At least nine killed in explosion at Pakistan market
item.description: At least nine people were killed and some 30 injured in a blast at a market in the Pakistani town of Sarai Naurang.

item.title: Report alleges Israel operated covert outpost in Iraq during war on Iran
item.description: According to The Wall Street Journal, Israel operated a military base in the Iraq during the US-Israeli war on Iran.

item.title: Why the Iran war is threatening whales near South Africa
item.description: Whales are increasingly exposed to traffic - and ship strikes.

item.title: Trump says Iran ceasefire is on 'massive life support'
item.description: The US president criticises an Iranian counteroffer to end the war, and says the month-long ceasefire is "unbelievably weak".

item.title: Lebanon says two paramedics among 10 killed in Israeli strikes
item.description: Lebanon's health ministry says the paramedics were carrying out a rescue mission in Nabatieh in response to an earlier attack that killed one person.
